subject.title: feat(webui): reintroduce opt-in AI purpose titles for tool calls

question: Should OpenClaw own this optional model-backed decorative title feature in core, including a new config key, operator-write RPC, provider egress, token spend, and persistent cache?
rationale: The explicit opt-in addresses the prior always-on objection, but implementation review cannot decide whether the new core configuration and protocol surfaces are worth the product and maintenance cost.

options.title: Approve after repairs
options.body: Keep the default off and land only after the routing, profile, cache, pane-waiter, mergeability, and live-proof requirements are satisfied.

options.title: Retain deterministic core
options.body: Decline the feature and keep current tool activity rendering model-free without the added configuration or protocol surface.

recommendation.title: Approve after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the default off and land only after the routing, profile, cache, pane-waiter, mergeability, and live-proof requirements are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository history identifies this person as the introducer and recent feature owner of both the original title path and its deterministic replacement.
